title: Let There Be Light
description: This pack adds a crafting recipe for light blocks, allowing illumination in your survival world.
body:
![Minecraft title text. The top is yellow, saying craft light blocks. The bottom is blue, saying abyssal vanguard.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/accc59c0fb626b4a440ede50a2125ada6f0e7136.png)
## Craft Light
This datapack adds a crafting recipe for light blocks to the game. It uses glowstone and glass panes, so it's not too expensive. You'll be able to light up your world in no time!

### Why This Matters
Illuminate Your World: Light blocks can make your world bright, and they don't take up any space! It's perfect for decoration in your build.
Easy Recipe: The recipe is survival-friendly, and its ingredients are not hard to obtain.
Multiplayer-Safe: The pack is lightweight and perfect for use in an SMP with your friends. Have fun making impenetrable defenses!

### Compatibility
Works with 1.21 and newer
Compatible with most datapacks and mods

This pack is perfect if you want to bring light into your survival world.

Made by MeowingChip5
